First time? Here's the drill

Bring
a helmet, front and rear lights (it's a dark-hours ride), water, a spare tube or patch kit, a way to pay for the stop.
Arrive
Ten or fifteen minutes before 6:00 pm. Tell whoever's leading that you're new.
Pace
Pace: no-drop. It's no-drop: if you fall off the back, someone waits. That's the point of a group ride.
Check
Look at @skiandbikeshop_gf the day of — that's where cancellations, weather calls and start changes get posted.

About the Ski & Bike Shop Thursday Road Ride group ride

A no-drop road ride from the shop on South Washington. New and experienced riders both show up. The shop also runs a Wednesday mountain bike ride at Lincoln Park starting in spring.
